RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly estimate from these facts

An all-male panel is worth querying as a procedural concern, but does not establish that sex influenced the decision. Assigning a percentage would imply evidence we do not have.

Your qualifications are strong, but the announcement alone cannot establish whose experience best matched the selection criteria.

Follow up your written request. Ask for the criteria, assessment of your application, reasons for preferring the successful candidate, and applicable panel-composition rules. You can neutrally ask whether those rules were followed.

The legal significance depends on the jurisdiction: some public-sector systems require gender-balanced panels. Check complaint deadlines now; do not assume your pending request pauses them.
